source.citation: Flora of North America vol. 26, Hesperaloe parviflora

source_reported_morphology.leaf_character: Dark green, barely constricted along length, margins with slender filament threads
source_reported_morphology.flower: Narrowly tubular rosy red to salmon perianth
source_reported_morphology.flowering_source_reported: Late winter to early summer (FNA study area; not Hays phenology)

comparison: FNA distinguishes H. funifera by broader, often yellow-green leaves (2–5 cm wide) and green/purple-tinged bell-shaped flowers; note that ornamental cultivars may not meet these wild-species floral characters.
limitation: FNA expressly cautions that ornamental and roadside planting obscures historic wild distributions. Record only as a morphology source caution; DO NOT perform any BONAP county-level or nativity determination here.
